proposal.summary: Information disclosure in GitLab EE allowed Group Owners to read the Public Key for a Google Cloud Logging audit event streaming destination when configured. Fixed in 16.2.5 and 16.3.1 by changing Owners to only be able to write the key, not read it.
proposal.cwe_quote: allowed other Group Owners to see the Public Key for a Google Cloud Logging audit event streaming destination, if configured.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Confirm whether the exposed public key can be used to impersonate or modify logs and whether any keys were accessed; notify affected customers to upgrade to 16.2.5 or 16.3.1 and rotate keys if necessary.
